guardrails: Current production code wins for values, layout, content, and interaction.
Reuse existing editable pages, components, variables, and styles before creating anything.
Keep the raw html.to.design import and Production Prototype as protected evidence.
Do not silently redesign; record existing design problems on Issues / Recorded Only.
Do not replace editable structures with whole-page screenshots.
Keep Drawer / Open as an independent mobile reference and overlay its hotspot on the menu control.
Document missing states as Not implemented in current code.

rawEvidenceProtection.promotionPolicy: Clone only an exact 1440, 768, or 390 viewport node as temporary geometry reference; rebuild the formal frame with editable structure, components, variables, placeholder media, and test text.

missingStatePolicy: Show the state with source evidence; otherwise add a clearly labeled Not implemented in current code record.

banner dot spacing reduces to zero; no other global layout change is declared at this threshold
low-height landscape drawer and player safeguards

responsivePatterns.desktop: Above 1180px: full navigation, header search, theme switcher, history, and user controls remain in the sticky header.
responsivePatterns.tablet: At 768px reference width: desktop navigation, header search, and theme switcher are hidden; the 44px menu control opens the mobile drawer.
responsivePatterns.mobile: At 390px: compact two-cell header, hidden header search/history text, 44px menu control, independent drawer/open state, and scroll locking.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Search, site-nav, theme switcher, history, and user surfaces change visibility at 1180/760 and short-landscape conditions.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Desktop inline navigation becomes an inert-background, focus-trapped mobile drawer with Escape/backdrop/close/focus-restoration behavior.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: retain the default information architecture and 6-column content grid; use a 96px Hero frog emblem, 4px SVG panel borders, hard pixel shadows, and a centered 640px Pixel Pass login panel.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: inherit the global 4-column and drawer rules until the 760px breakpoint; the Pixel Frog login panel remains source-sized while surrounding padding contracts.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: reduce the Hero emblem to 68px, use a vertical darkening overlay, span the Pixel Frog theme choice across the drawer grid, and compact the login panel; below 520px the Pixel Pass avatar becomes 44px and the login title is 38px.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Pixel Pass is visible only for Pixel Frog; the Liquid Cinema login glow/highlight layers are hidden. Reduced motion removes particles, emblem hop, login entrance, and READY blinking without hiding content.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Uses the same inert, focus-trapped mobile drawer as the default theme; only the Pixel Frog option spans the full mobile theme grid.
responsivePatterns.cards: Inherits the global 6 → 4 → 2 grid. Fine-pointer hover moves eligible Pixel Frog cards -3px/-3px and expands the hard shadow to 8px; coarse-pointer/mobile layouts do not receive that hover lift.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: one large hero, five-column rank list, six genre chips, six-column video grids, and four continue-watching cards.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: rank becomes a horizontal rail, genres reduce to three columns, and video/catalog grids use four columns.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: hero actions use two equal columns; rank, genre, tabs, and continue-watching become touch-scroll rails; video shelves use two columns.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Compact mobile hides selected banner metadata and collapses the header while scrolling; reduced motion disables autoplay movement.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Hero/card actions continue to detail/player routes; carousel pause remains an explicit control.
responsivePatterns.cards: 6 → 4 → 2 video columns; rank 5-column grid → horizontal rail; genre 6 → 3 → horizontal rail.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: six video columns, four category tiles, multi-row filters, and inline channel search.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: four video/category columns; filters retain scrollable options and compact spacing.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: two video/category columns, one-column filter rows, full-width channel search, and wrapped paging controls.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Filter options remain horizontally reachable; empty results replace grids with a single full-width state.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Search/category/filter selections resolve to MacCMS URL-helper routes and pagination retains page-jump behavior.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: 240–290px poster beside the detail panel, three interaction columns, and inline source-quality controls.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: 230px poster beside content until the mobile breakpoint; spacing and title scale reduce.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: poster and content stack; poster centers at min(250px, 62vw); actions stretch and interaction/source-quality panels become one column.
responsivePatterns.visibility: No core detail action is removed; source metadata wraps and quality controls stack.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Primary action opens the selected episode; episode/source links retain sid/nid; download, plot, favorite, and feedback routes remain explicit.
responsivePatterns.cards: Two-column hero → one-column stack; three interaction panels → one column.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: titled player page, 16:9 shell, inline toolbar, and eight-column episode grid.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: the 16:9 shell and standard controls remain; the episode grid reduces to five columns through the 1020px theme rule.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: head/toolbar stack, episode grid uses three columns, toolbar label hides, and theme-player controls become 38px. Artplayer status padding reduces below 640px; preload/buffering prompts narrow below 560px.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Toolbar descriptive text hides at 760px; short landscape at height 520px hides the player head and makes the shell edge-to-edge; prompt artwork compacts again below 300px height.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Episode, failover, retry, auto-next, and same-episode line-switch behavior remain tied to player data and playback recovery.
responsivePatterns.cards: Episode links 8 → 5 → 3; player remains 16:9 except short-landscape full-height mode.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: centered glass authentication panel; history/favorite/device records retain multi-column metadata and action layouts.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: record toolbars and action groups wrap; device and secondary account layouts prepare to stack.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: login padding and title scale reduce, captcha becomes two rows below 520px, record actions stretch, and device cards become one column.
responsivePatterns.visibility: No authentication field is removed; decorative motion is disabled for reduced motion.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Login/register/find-password return through MacCMS user routes; account dashboard links to records, favorites, and device management.
responsivePatterns.cards: Record/favorite/device multi-column layouts → compact metadata rows → stacked action layouts.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: feedback/content plus sticky system/form panels where implemented; download links and paging stay inline.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: layouts reduce spacing while keeping the same route/form hierarchy.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: comment/download/detail interaction layouts become one column; system box padding reduces; paging and page-jump controls wrap full width.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Captcha, permission, copyright, password, and error messages remain present; unsupported states are recorded rather than hidden.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Submit, verification, jump, report, pagination, and protected-content routes remain MacCMS-native.
responsivePatterns.cards: Multi-column feedback/download layouts → one-column form and result flow.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: two-column game hub; multiplayer game/room panels share the canvas; 2048 and Blockrain use desktop board controls.
responsivePatterns.tablet: At 980px and below: multiplayer layouts stack and the room panel stops sticking.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: one game card per row, vertically stacked actions, responsive board widths, Blockrain next panel above the board; below 420px actions and color controls stack further.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Guest/member access states switch the hub content; reduced motion removes tile/stone/orbit animations.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Guest gate leads to login; member hub leads to each game and multiplayer lobby/room flows.
responsivePatterns.cards: Game hub 2 → 2/stacked multiplayer → 1; board controls reorganize without removing gameplay actions.

responsivePatterns.desktop: 1440 reference: directory grids/lists use the shared six-card or four-category patterns; details use full content width with related modules.
responsivePatterns.tablet: 768 reference: shared directory grids use four columns and long metadata wraps.
responsivePatterns.mobile: 390 reference: directory grids use two columns, list thumbnails reduce to 86px, and content/related modules stack.
responsivePatterns.visibility: Empty directories replace their grid with one full-width empty state; machine RSS/map outputs never receive visual frames.
responsivePatterns.navigation: Directory, search, pagination, and detail routes remain specific to article/topic/actor/role/website modules.
responsivePatterns.cards: Shared directory cards 6 → 4 → 2; list rows retain thumbnail + content at compact widths.
